reconfigure.title: Update the connection details
reconfigure.description: Device ID `{device_id}` is fixed: it is what identifies this entry, so a different device ID would be a different device. The other three do move. Re-pairing in the Smart Life app mints a new local key, a DHCP lease can move the IP address, and a firmware update can move the protocol version. The new values are tried against the device before anything is saved — if they fail, the entry is left exactly as it was.

user.title: Connect to the diffuser
user.description: Device ID, local key and protocol version come from the recon step (tuya-local-key QR login or `tinytuya wizard`). The local key is a live credential — it is stored in Home Assistant's config entry like any other integration secret.

error.cannot_connect: The device did not answer with these credentials. Check the IP address, local key and protocol version.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to read the device. Lower is fresher but competes with the Tuya app, which may share the device's single local connection.
